mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a pleasant 82 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Verona City Hall. The moon is currently in its third quarter phase.

The City of Verona is offering a new tri-shaw bike program for seniors to enjoy the Military Ridge State Trail, and the Recreation Department is currently seeking applicants for seasonal jobs, including adult fitness instructors.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, the downtown farmers market, or trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In a report from the Verona Police Department, an officer conducted a stop on July 31 for an equipment violation, which led to the arrest of a driver for O W I and other traffic citations.
Today's featured flavor is creamy Butter Pecan, which you can enjoy at Culver's until they close at 10 PM tonight. If you cannot make it, tomorrow's flavor will be Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
